steps: Soak pitted dates in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain.
Peel and dice mango into small pieces, reserving half for topping.
Blend soaked dates, half the mango, coconut milk, vanilla extract, and lemon juice until smooth.
Pour blended mixture into a large bowl and whisk in chia seeds thoroughly.
Let mixture rest for 5 minutes, whisk once more to prevent clumping.
Divide mixture evenly among 4 small cups or jars.
Refrigerate cups for at least 2 hours, or overnight, until fully set.
Top each cup with the reserved diced mango before serving. Keep refrigerated for up to 3 days.
